listing.name: MoreVanillaBounties
listing.summary: Adds More Vanilla bounties (3x more min and max) and More Vanilla bounties (Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounties)
listing.aiSummary: Increases vanilla bounty values by three times and adds new Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary bounty types.

description: Triples the minimum and maximum values for standard bounties. Introduces additional bounty categories including Remnant, Derelict, Pather, and Mercenary. Includes numerous configuration sliders via LunaLib.
